scope: material decision-bearing candidates/components from E0 through E14v plus unresolved architecture surfaces
classification_rules: Historical DEV and historical VALIDATION are EXPOSED_POOL development/selection evidence under P12.
Historical hard-gate failures remain failures and cannot become QUALIFIED solely because P12 changed split roles.
A component can remain QUALIFIED only for the property actually demonstrated by its evidence.
Synthetic evidence can qualify robustness/evaluator/judge behavior but cannot establish real-domain production generalization.
EXPERIMENT_FROZEN reproducibility is distinct from project-level FROZEN selection.
No historical implementation candidate is promoted to PREFERRED or project-level FROZEN by this reinterpretation.
